Substituting this into the equation above, we get -3a - 3 ≡ 0 (mod p), which implies that a ≡ -1 (mod p). Therefore, f(x) has a root mod p.

Substituting this into the equation above, we get -3a - 3 ≡ 0 (mod p), which implies that a ≡ -1 (mod p). Since a ≡ -1 (mod p), we have a ≡ 2 (mod p). Therefore, p ≡ 1 (mod 3).

Therefore, we have shown that f(x) has roots mod p if and only if p ≡ 1 (mod 3).
